author: bersbersbers

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: The current AutoSuggestBox receives an unfiltered MRU list.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: Filter suggestions and preserve explicit dismissal.

judgment.rationale: Current XAML and initialization code directly confirm the behavior: SearchMRU is populated with every non-empty history entry and assigned as the AutoSuggestBox ItemsSource without filtering.
evidence: The screenshot/report shows unrelated history such as “tonga” while typing “cou.”
Current MainWindow.xaml binds SearchMRU directly to the AutoSuggestBox ItemsSource.
MainWindow::InitAutoComplete appends every stored MRU string with no prefix or fuzzy filtering.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused design to filter MRU suggestions by current search text and make dismissal behavior non-obstructive.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix filters the displayed MRU list; current source directly matches the reported behavior.

proposed_fixes.title: Filter PowerRename MRU suggestions before presenting them
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The AutoSuggestBox receives the entire persisted search MRU as its ItemsSource. Because the list is not filtered by current Text, unrelated entries are displayed and normal AutoSuggestBox text changes reopen the popup.
plan: Maintain a full MRU store but expose a filtered observable list based on the current search text, using case-insensitive prefix or contains semantics agreed with UX.
On TextChanged, update suggestions without changing the user’s text or selection; preserve explicit dismissal until the next meaningful query or focus transition.
Keep the existing autocomplete-enabled setting and MRU persistence behavior.
verification: Add UI coverage that “cou” does not offer unrelated “tonga” and does offer matching history.
Verify Escape closes suggestions without altering the search and typing can intentionally reopen only with matching items.
Verify disabling autocomplete shows no history and rename preview updates normally.

confidence.rationale: The unfiltered ItemsSource is directly visible in current source and precisely matches the reported unrelated suggestions.

issue_context.summary: PowerRename binds the search AutoSuggestBox directly to the complete MRU list, so unrelated previous terms are offered for any current input and the suggestion popup naturally reopens after each text change.
known_information: The issue originated from #15594 but remained after that obscured-button issue was closed.
The dropdown contains unrelated prior terms and reopens after each keypress.
Current settings still include an autocomplete toggle.
inferences: Filtering the displayed MRU resolves the correctness complaint; popup dismissal semantics may need a small UX decision.
issue_context.analysis: The current implementation has no query filter between stored MRU values and displayed suggestions, providing a concrete root cause and narrow change.
